standard_prerequisites.use: Computes the pushforward of the box product.

core_obligations: Choose m, n with O_Delta in smd(add(E boxtimes G[-m,m])^{star n}).
Twist by Lpr_1^* K, use the displayed box-tensor identity, and push forward: the result is the displayed smd(add(RGamma tensor G[-m,m])^{star n}).
Boundedness of cohomology of K absorbs the [a,b] window, landing K in the n-th hull of G.
proof_roadmap: Display the tensor identity, push forward, then absorb the cohomology window into the smd bound.
difficulty_reason: smd/add/star calculus with a projection-formula computation and boundedness bookkeeping; fully displayed.
